title: Ko
desc: Ashwin, a photojournalist, supports his friend, Vasanthan, who is contesting in the upcoming elections. However, he is shocked when he realises that Vasanthan has connections with the Naxalites.

title: Ushiran
desc: Murugavel, a police officer, learns that his younger brother is a petty criminal working for a local gangster. When he tries to bring about a positive change in him, the brother tries to kill him.

title: Vanamagan
desc: Kavya, a rich girl, goes to a restricted area in Andaman to celebrate the New Year with her friends. While evading the forest officers in the jungle, she knocks Jara, a tribal man, with her car.

title: Raghuraman IAS
desc: A man harbours negative feelings towards his younger brother since childhood. However, complications arise when he goes to extreme lengths to make his life miserable.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Aathi
desc: A young boy moves to Chennai for his education where he meets a girl and falls in love with her. Soon, they learn that they are both on a mission to avenge the death of their parents.
